advisories.reason: Every published braces is affected (the advisory range is <=3.0.3 and 3.0.3 is the latest), so no version resolves it. It arrives only through micromatch -> fast-glob, which stylelint and purgecss use to walk the source tree; both are already at their latest, and npm's proposed fix is a major downgrade of stylelint. Nothing ships it to a browser and no untrusted string reaches it: the globs are written in this repo's own config and scripts.
